text:
Type: woven rattan plant pot
Use: holding a potted floor plant; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: bohemian, Scandinavian, coastal
Materials: hand-woven rattan in a two-tone weave, grey-stained and natural strands
Colors: dark grey, natural beige rattan
Shape: tall round basket that tapers slightly toward the base, dense diagonal weave, two cut-out handles below the rim, sturdy and textured
Feel: natural, earthy, warm, crafted
Goes with: large green plants, light wood, linen, white or grey walls; bohemian, Scandinavian or coastal rooms

product.name: RGKORN
product.description: A plastic inner pot makes the plant pot waterproof.
